newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ cuts 1-yr fixed rates for businesses, farms.
newsitem.headline: BNZ cuts 1-yr fixed rates for businesses, farms.

text.p: The Bank of New Zealand said on Thursday it had cut its business and farm 12-month fixed lending rates to 10.75 percent from 10.95 percent.
The bank also cut its two to five year fixed lending rates for businesses and farms to 10.25 percent from 11.25 percent.
The new lending rates take effect on Friday.
BNZ managing director Gordon Wheaton said the reductions followed reductions to the two and three year fixed rate housing loans last week.

"The bank is responding consistently to the decreases in the long term wholesale interest rates. We've passed that benefit on to housing loan customers and now we're doing the same for our business and farming customers," he said.
